// Fused Swin block: one threadgroup = one window (16 tokens, dim=32)
// 32 lanes per wave; lanes 0..15 each own one token. Lanes 16..31 idle for attn,
// help with MLP hidden=128 (4 hidden channels per lane).

#define DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128
#define WIN 4
#define N 16          // tokens per window = WIN*WIN
#define W 1280
#define H 720
#define NW (W/WIN)    // 320
#define NH (H/WIN)    // 180

Buffer<float16_t> g_in       : register(t0);
Buffer<float16_t> g_rpe      : register(t1);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n1w      : register(t2);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n1b      : register(t3);
Buffer<float16_t> g_qkvw     : register(t4);  // (96,32)
Buffer<float16_t> g_qkvb     : register(t5);
Buffer<float16_t> g_projw    : register(t6);  // (32,32)
Buffer<float16_t> g_projb    : register(t7);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n2w      : register(t8);
Buffer<float16_t> g_n2b      : register(t9);
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc1w     : register(t10); // (128,32)
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc1b     : register(t11);
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc2w     : register(t12); // (32,128)
Buffer<float16_t> g_fc2b     : register(t13);

// Sizes in bytes (fp16=2):
//  rpe: 256*2 = 512
//  n1w/b, n2w/b: 32*2 * 4 = 256
//  qkvw: 3072*2 = 6144 ; qkvb: 192
//  projw: 1024*2 = 2048 ; projb: 64
//  fc1w: 4096*2 = 8192 ; fc1b: 256
//  fc2w: 4096*2 = 8192 ; fc2b: 64
// Total ~25.7 KB

groupshared float16_t s_n1w[DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_n1b[DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_n2w[DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_n2b[DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_qkvw[3*DIM*DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_qkvb[3*DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_projw[DIM*DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_projb[DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_fc1w[HIDDEN*DIM];
groupshared float16_t s_fc1b[HIDDEN];
groupshared float16_t s_fc2w[DIM*HIDDEN];
groupshared float16_t s_fc2b[DIM];

groupshared float16_t s_qkv[N * 3 * DIM]; // 16 * 96 = 1536 * 2 = 3072B
groupshared float s_attn[N * N];          // 256 floats = 1024B
groupshared float16_t s_av[N * DIM];      // 16*32 = 512 * 2 = 1024B
groupshared float16_t s_hidden[N * HIDDEN]; // 16*128 = 2048 *2 = 4096B
// total working ~ 9.2 KB; weights ~25.7 KB => over 32KB. Need to overlap.
// We'll alias s_hidden over s_qkv+s_av+s_attn by reusing.
// But HLSL doesn't allow union. Instead, drop s_av (can recompute via registers).

// Approach: keep s_qkv (qkv outputs) and s_attn for softmax. After AV,
// store proj+residual back to global. For MLP, reuse s_qkv as s_hidden region? sizes:
//   s_qkv = 1536 fp16 = 3072B; s_hidden needs 2048 fp16 = 4096B -> doesn't fit alias.
// Let's just keep all. Total: weights 25.7KB + working 9.2KB = 34.9KB -> too much.
//
// Remove s_av (8 active lanes can broadcast attn rows through wave intrinsics
// or recompute). Drop s_hidden: stream hidden one-channel at a time isn't trivial
// since fc2 needs all 128. Keep s_hidden, drop s_av:
//   working = 3072 + 1024 + 4096 = 8192B = 8KB.
//   weights = 25.7KB; total = 33.7KB still over.
//
// Move fc1w & fc2w out of groupshared (read from SRV each time) — they're 8KB each.
// Without fc1w/fc2w groupshared: weights = 25.7 - 16 = 9.7KB; working 8KB; total 17.7KB OK.
// (Reads from L2 are still fine; the weights are small and cache-resident across tg.)

// To stay valid, we redefine without fc1w/fc2w groupshared.

    uint nh = window_id / NW;
    uint nw = window_id % NW;
    uint y0 = nh * WIN;
    uint x0 = nw * WIN;

    uint lane = tid;

    // --- Cooperative load of weights into groupshared ---
    // rpe 256
    if (lane < 32) {
        for (uint i = lane; i < 256; i += 32) s_rpe[i] = g_rpe[i];
    }
    // norms (32 each)
    if (lane < DIM) {
        s_n1w[lane] = g_n1w[lane];
        s_n1b[lane] = g_n1b[lane];
        s_n2w[lane] = g_n2w[lane];
        s_n2b[lane] = g_n2b[lane];
        s_projb[lane] = g_projb[lane];
        s_fc2b[lane] = g_fc2b[lane];
    }
    // qkvw 3072, qkvb 96

    for (uint i = lane; i < 3*DIM; i += 32) s_qkvb[i] = g_qkvb[i];

    // fc1b 128, fc2 weights skipped (use SRV directly), fc1w skipped too — use SRV.

    bool active = lane < N;
    uint token = lane;            // 0..15
    uint ty = token / WIN;        // 0..3
    uint tx = token % WIN;        // 0..3
    uint gy = y0 + ty;
    uint gx = x0 + tx;
    uint base = ((0 * H + gy) * W + gx) * DIM;

    // Load token vector x_in (DIM=32) into registers
    float16_t x_in[DIM];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
        x_in[c] = active ? g_in[base + c] : (float16_t)0;
    }

    // --- LN1 ---
    float mean = 0.0, var = 0.0;
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
        float v = (float)x_in[c];
        mean += v;
    }
    mean /= (float)DIM;
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
        float v = (float)x_in[c] - mean;
        var += v*v;
    }
    var /= (float)DIM;
    float inv = rsqrt(var + 1e-5);

    float16_t x_norm[DIM];
    [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
        float v = ((float)x_in[c] - mean) * inv;
        x_norm[c] = (float16_t)(v * (float)s_n1w[c] + (float)s_n1b[c]);
    }

    // --- QKV linear: out[3*DIM] = qkvw * x_norm + qkvb ---
    // qkvw layout: (96, 32), row-major => index = row*32 + col
    float16_t q[DIM], k[DIM], v[DIM];
    [unroll] for (uint r = 0; r < DIM; ++r) {
        float accq = (float)s_qkvb[r];
        float acck = (float)s_qkvb[DIM + r];
        float accv = (float)s_qkvb[2*DIM + r];
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
            float xv = (float)x_norm[c];
            accq += (float)s_qkvw[r*DIM + c] * xv;
            acck += (float)s_qkvw[(DIM + r)*DIM + c] * xv;
            accv += (float)s_qkvw[(2*DIM + r)*DIM + c] * xv;
        }
        q[r] = (float16_t)accq;
        k[r] = (float16_t)acck;
        v[r] = (float16_t)accv;
    }

    // s_qkv layout: [token, 0:Q | 1:K | 2:V, ch]

        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
            s_qkv[token * 3 * DIM + 0 * DIM + c] = q[c];
            s_qkv[token * 3 * DIM + 1 * DIM + c] = k[c];
            s_qkv[token * 3 * DIM + 2 * DIM + c] = v[c];
        }
    }
    GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync();

    // --- Attention scores: attn[i,j] = (q_i . k_j) * scale + rpe[i,j] ---
    // Each active lane i computes its row of 16 scores.
    const float scale = 1.0 / sqrt((float)DIM); // C^-0.5
    float row[N];
    if (active) {
        [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            float dot = 0.0;
            [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
                dot += (float)q[c] * (float)s_qkv[j * 3 * DIM + 1 * DIM + c];
            }
            row[j] = dot * scale + (float)s_rpe[token * N + j];
        }
        // softmax over row
        float m = row[0];
        [unroll] for (uint j = 1; j < N; ++j) m = max(m, row[j]);
        float sum = 0.0;
        [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            row[j] = exp(row[j] - m);
            sum += row[j];
        }
        float invs = 1.0 / sum;
        [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) row[j] *= invs;
    }

    // --- AV: out_i[c] = sum_j attn[i,j] * V[j,c] ---
    float16_t av[DIM];
    if (active) {
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
            float acc = 0.0;
            [unroll] for (uint j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                acc += row[j] * (float)s_qkv[j * 3 * DIM + 2 * DIM + c];
            }
            av[c] = (float16_t)acc;
        }
    }

    // --- Proj: y = projw * av + projb, then residual add with x_in ---
    float16_t post_attn[DIM];
    if (active) {
        [unroll] for (uint r = 0; r < DIM; ++r) {
            float acc = (float)s_projb[r];
            [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {

            post_attn[r] = (float16_t)(acc + (float)x_in[r]);
        }
    }

    // --- LN2 ---
    float mean2 = 0.0, var2 = 0.0;
    if (active) {

        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
            float vv = (float)post_attn[c] - mean2;
            var2 += vv*vv;
        }
        var2 /= (float)DIM;
    }
    float inv2 = rsqrt(var2 + 1e-5);
    float16_t x_norm2[DIM];
    if (active) {
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
            float vv = ((float)post_attn[c] - mean2) * inv2;
            x_norm2[c] = (float16_t)(vv * (float)s_n2w[c] + (float)s_n2b[c]);
        }
    }

    // --- FC1: hidden[h] = fc1w[h,:] . x_norm2 + fc1b[h], then GELU ---
    // hidden=128; store to s_hidden so fc2 can read across.
    // fc1w from SRV (not in groupshared)
    if (active) {
        [unroll] for (uint h = 0; h < HIDDEN; ++h) {
            float acc = (float)s_fc1b[h];
            [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
                acc += (float)g_fc1w[h * DIM + c] * (float)x_norm2[c];
            }
            // GELU (tanh approx)
            float xg = acc;
            float gelu = 0.5 * xg * (1.0 + tanh(0.7978845608 * (xg + 0.044715 * xg * xg * xg)));
            s_hidden[token * HIDDEN + h] = (float16_t)gelu;
        }
    }
    // No barrier needed: same lane writes/reads its own row.

    // --- FC2: out[c] = fc2w[c,:] . hidden + fc2b[c], add residual post_attn ---
    if (active) {
        float16_t outv[DIM];
        [unroll] for (uint r = 0; r < DIM; ++r) {
            float acc = (float)s_fc2b[r];
            [unroll] for (uint h = 0; h < HIDDEN; ++h) {
                acc += (float)g_fc2w[r * HIDDEN + h] * (float)s_hidden[token * HIDDEN + h];
            }
            outv[r] = (float16_t)(acc + (float)post_attn[r]);
        }
        // Store back to global
        [unroll] for (uint c = 0; c < DIM; ++c) {
            g_out[base + c] = outv[c];
        }
    }
